claim: Kandy MC population fell from 98,828 in 2012 to 94,482 in 2024 (-4.4%); over the same census interval Colombo MC fell about 9.3% while Gampaha MC rose about 2.0%.

metric.denominator: resident population inside unchanged-named municipal council units at each census
metric.geography: Kandy MC, Colombo MC, Gampaha MC
metric.basis: percentage change calculated from DCS local-authority census totals
metric.source_definition: administrative municipal population change; not metropolitan growth or economic performance

bounded_by: Boundary/coverage changes must be checked before treating differences as pure demographic change; municipal decline does not by itself prove urban stagnation.
notes: Directly tests the 'second city' framing against comparable municipal units.
